title: Sheikh Lotfollah Mosque
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Sheikh Lotfollah Mosque exterior: warm pointed dome on blue cylindrical drum, small bead finial, recessed blue pointed entrance with broad original faceted vault cells, pale base and low brick body. Exact main outline and mapped rounded roof-part retained; main mapped total 32 m guides top. Five existing shared 256² graphs, seven merged material roles and four budgeted browser LODs. Bazaar, square, exact tile artwork, hidden passage/interiors and precise terrain joins remain outside this asset.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained exact way 244271852 / Q856356 is current viewer building 35184616360684. Its six current outer vertices, original anchor and heading remain fixed. Current rounded building part 35185027499279 / way655410447 has 19 outer vertices and guides the drum/dome plan. Positive Z points approximately west-southwest toward the square and entrance; positive X approximately south-southeast along the frontage. Two pictures guide the signed entrance, dome and blue drum. The entrance is centered approximately at local [-2.55,21.4]. Detailed roof divisions, entrance dimensions and side/rear bays are estimates. Long neighboring bazaar building 35184756945754 and the square remain host content; they are not absorbed into this mosque model.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Retained map and current PMTiles main-building height are 32 m; retained dome-height statement is also 32 m. Use 32 m as whole-model finial top above the working floor, not as an eaves height. There is no independently mapped roof-part height or datum. Visualization subdivisions: main low roof 11.8 m, front flanks 11.8 m, blue drum 11.8–16.8 m, warm pointed dome 16.8–30.8 m and small bead finial to 32 m; blue entrance frame 16.5 m with pointed recess top 14.7 m. Detailed subheights and roof profiles are estimates. No minarets or open courtyard are added. Fine tile/calligraphic artwork, hidden corridors, muqarnas patterns and furnished interiors are omitted or broadly abstracted.
